role: canonical nonlinear/chaotic benchmark processes; not claimed to be a single established benchmark collection

common.observed_dimension: one univariate scalar series per process
common.contamination: same frozen relative Gaussian observation-noise mechanism used for the custom DGP suite
common.dgp_seeds: use the disjoint development/final DGP seed domains already frozen in synthetic_split_v2.json

logistic_map.initial_condition: x0 ~ Uniform(0.1,0.9) from the DGP seed

henon_map.initial_condition: x0,y0 independently ~ Uniform(-0.5,0.5) from the DGP seed
henon_map.reference: Henon 1976, Communications in Mathematical Physics, doi:10.1007/BF01608556

lorenz63.initial_condition: x0~Uniform(-15,15), y0~Uniform(-20,20), z0~Uniform(5,35), independently from the DGP seed
lorenz63.reference: Lorenz 1963, Journal of the Atmospheric Sciences, doi:10.1175/1520-0469(1963)020<0130:DNF>2.0.CO;2

scope_note: These processes supplement, rather than replace, the six custom stress-test DGPs.
